# listSurveyQuestions — GET /surveyQuestions

List survey questions

## Verified behaviors

- **The list arrives in the pagination envelope — empty in this committee** — Survey questions come back in the standard `{items, count, nextPageLink}` envelope. The sandbox committee has no survey questions (and none can be created — every `type` is rejected), so the empty page is the only response this database can produce. ([replay](../behaviors/survey-questions-list-is-an-empty-page-here.md))
- **$top is bounded 1–200, and the API's own hint says so** — A `$top` outside 1–200 is refused with INVALID_PARAMETER, and the refusal states the real bounds — maximum 200 in the text, default 50 in the hint — contradicting the official docs' claimed default of 40. ([replay](../behaviors/survey-questions-top-bounds-come-from-the-api.md))

## Behavior

Returns the context's survey questions, each with its canned responses, in the standard pagination envelope. Every filter is optional; with none set, Active questions are returned. The sandbox committee has no survey questions, so only the empty page has been observed live.

## Differs from the official docs

- **parameters / $top** — Official docs claim a default of 40; the API's own INVALID_PARAMETER hint (observed 2026-08-03) states default 50, maximum 200.

## Example

```bash
curl -sS -X GET \
  'https://api.securevan.com/v4/surveyQuestions?statuses=['Active', 'Archived']' \
  -u "app-name:$NGP_API_KEY|1"
```

## Query parameters

| Name | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `statuses` | array of string | Statuses to include, comma-delimited. Defaults to Active. One of: `Active`, `Archived`, `Inactive`. |
| `name` | string | Filters to survey questions whose name starts with the given input. |
| `type` | string | Filters to survey questions of the given type. |
| `question` | string | Filters to survey questions whose script question contains the given input. |
| `cycle` | integer (int32) | A year in the format YYYY. |
| `$top` | integer (int32) | Limits the number of results. Default 50, maximum 200. |

`*` = required.

### `200` body — SurveyQuestionList

The envelope every paginated endpoint returns around its `items` array.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nextPageLink` | string (uri) or null | Absolute URL of the next page — including an explicit `:443` port — or null on the last page. e.g. `https://api.securevan.com:443/v4/people?lastName=Testperson&$top=1&$skip=1` |
| `count` * | integer | Total number of matches across all pages, not the size of this page. |
| `items` * | array of object |  |
| `items.surveyQuestionId` | integer | Unique identifier of the question. |
| `items.type` | string or null | Category of question, e.g. "GOTV". The full set of values is not known — POST /surveyQuestions rejected every type tried in the sandbox. |
| `items.cycle` | integer or null | Election year the question belongs to, as YYYY. |
| `items.name` | string or null | Full name of the question. |
| `items.mediumName` | string or null | Abbreviated name, for displays with limited room. |
| `items.shortName` | string or null | Shortest form of the name, for the tightest displays. |
| `items.scriptQuestion` | string or null | The question as read aloud to the person. |
| `items.status` | string or null | Whether the question is in use. |
| `items.responses` | array of object or null | The canned answers a canvasser can record against this question. |
